doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd). steps: [id, the one banner line]. %W swing or shoot, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for a variant of a step (the right click with a hold, the Boki starting out). labels: the marker's caption per step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (hp and size up, damage and attack tempo down). need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill.
steps: Steer to land on the meadow
Jump, then dash in the air
Climb up and hold to crouch
Tap to send %s at the monster

alt.throw_send: Tap again to send %s at the monster
